problem.title: Join Two Binary Search Trees
problem.problemStatement: Given two Binary Search Trees where every key in the first tree is smaller than every key in the second tree, combine them into a single valid Binary Search Tree.
problem.input: • The first line contains N₁. • The next N₁ lines describe the first BST. • The following line contains N₂. • The next N₂ lines describe the second BST.
